A specification of std::type_info::operator==

An assumed specification of the library function, for clients to link (for instance cpp.spec "std::type_info::operator==(const std::type_info&) const" with (\this this \exact type_info_eq_wpp this)>> with auto). It is not an axiom: a client that uses it assumes it of its library.
bool operator==(const type_info& rhs) const noexcept; returns whether both objects represent the same type (<https://eel.is/c++draft/type.info2>). Comparing [type]s is sound because the <> rules only give [type_infoR ty] for [ty] in [typeid_ok], where cpp2v prints each C++ type in one way and distinct C++ types differently (see ../logic/typeid.v). C++20 rewrites <> to <>; the C++17 member <> has the dual specification.

Section with_cpp.
  Context `{Σ : cpp_logic} {σ : genv}.

  Definition type_info_eq_wpp (this : ptr) : WpSpec_cpp_val :=
    \arg{rhs} "" (Vref rhs)
    \prepost{t1} this |-> type_infoR t1
    \prepost{t2} rhs |-> type_infoR t2
    \post[Vbool (bool_decide (t1 = t2))] emp.

  Definition type_info_eq_spec : function_spec :=
    SMethod "std::type_info" QC Tbool ["const std::type_info&"%cpp_type] (fun this =>
      cpp_spec Tbool ["const std::type_info&"%cpp_type] (type_info_eq_wpp this)).

bool operator!=(const type_info& rhs) const noexcept; (C++17)
  Definition type_info_neq_wpp (this : ptr) : WpSpec_cpp_val :=
    \arg{rhs} "" (Vref rhs)
    \prepost{t1} this |-> type_infoR t1
    \prepost{t2} rhs |-> type_infoR t2
    \post[Vbool (bool_decide (t1 <> t2))] emp.

  Definition type_info_neq_spec : function_spec :=
    SMethod "std::type_info" QC Tbool ["const std::type_info&"%cpp_type] (fun this =>
      cpp_spec Tbool ["const std::type_info&"%cpp_type] (type_info_neq_wpp this)).
